text: My company is being acquired and the contract needs to be assigned to the new legal entity. What's the process?
Hi, I wrote last week and the week before about switching to the annual plan at the Black Friday price. The offer ends on Sunday. Could someone please respond?
Please confirm whether we can lock in the current per-seat rate if we sign a 2-year term. The price increase takes effect on the 1st, which is four days away, so we'd need paperwork this week.

Since your acquisition, everything we valued has been stripped from our enterprise plan and the support SLA is ignored week after week. 1,800 users here. We're done waiting. Send me the early termination terms TODAY, or send someone who can fix the relationship. Your call.
I need to reduce my hosting plan from the 8GB to the 4GB tier. Traffic has fallen. Can you move me to the smaller plan?
Could I get a formal quote for 25 seats on the annual plan? We need a PDF for our purchasing system.

We are a reseller on your platform. Today's billing run appears to have invoiced all of our sub-accounts at list price rather than contract price - roughly 1,100 invoices, several already auto-collected. Please halt collection and advise.
I'm travelling next Monday and wanted to buy the international roaming pack, but the app says it's not offered on my plan. Can I be moved to an eligible plan before then?

This is what, the sixth time I ask for the SOC 2 report for our enterprise renewal? Our security team has blocked the renewal, the contract dies on Friday, and 1,200 of our people lose the tool. If that happens we're not coming back. HOW hard is it to send a PDF?

I've been stuck in your billing chat queue for 40 mins just to ask for an itemized statement. Forty. Minutes. Does anybody actually work there? Send me the itemized statement for the acct ending 8830 and spare me the apology script.
The autocorrect in your editor keeps changing "its" to "it's". It is WRONG half the time and there is no way to turn it off that I can find. Infuriating piece of software.
This is my third email about refund #R-20931. I was told 5-7 business days on the 2nd. It's now the 24th. Could someone please give me an actual status?
We're interested in a paid pilot for our Berlin office (~40 people) before a broader rollout. Could someone set up a call in the coming weeks?
Could the statement view include a running balance column? My old bank had this and I miss it.

Delivery drivers across the whole city can't accept jobs - the driver app logs everyone out instantly. Restaurants are calling me, food is going cold, and your status page says "All systems operational". What a bad joke.
Hi, we'd like to convert our three separate team accounts into a single organisation contract. Is that possible, and would the price per seat change?
The unread badge on the inbox icon shows 3 but there are no unread messages, so I keep opening the app to look for messages that aren't there. Reinstalling didn't help.
An option to export invoices in bulk as a ZIP would help our accountant. Currently it's one at a time, which works, it's just tedious.
Transfer to my family in Manila arrived in 40 seconds and the fee was lower than advertised. I've told everyone at work.

Our hospital group has raised the same contract-compliance issue (the missing BAA) with your team every month since February. The compliance committee meets Wednesday and the agenda item is replacing your product across all 11 facilities. A signed BAA before then would change the outcome.
PDF reports generated from the analytics tab cut off the last column when there are more than 8 columns.
The footer on your status page still says (c) 2023. Not important, obviously.
My card expires next month and I tried adding the new one but it says "card type not supported". It's a regular Visa debit. Current card still works for now so no emergency.
Got billed for 3 extra seats we never added. We have 5 users, the invoice and the card charge say 8. Please correct and refund the difference.
What's included in the enterprise tier beyond SSO? Looking for a features-and-price overview I can share internally, no timeline yet.

Writing on behalf of the university's IT procurement office. Due to the continued unavailability of the accessibility compliance documentation (VPAT), first requested in January, we cannot lawfully renew the campus-wide license, which lapses on the 30th. Unless the documentation arrives this week, 28,000 accounts will be migrated to an alternative.

We operate 600 retail stores on your POS contract. Hardware replacements promised under the agreement have been backordered for four months and stores are limping along on spare units. Leadership has asked me to get exit terms. Before I do that, can your account director call me today?
Your size guide is fiction. Ordered a medium per YOUR chart, got something that fits my 10 year old. I'll deal with the return myself, but fix the damn chart before you waste more people's time.
The app only lets me log meals in grams, and I cook with cups and ounces, so I keep making conversion mistakes in my diabetes log. Imperial units would really help me.
I can't log in. Password reset emails never arrive (checked spam). I've been locked out since this morning and need to get to my files.
Second ticket about this: our SSO login loop. After authenticating with Okta I'm bounced back to the login page. I'm the only one affected as far as I know, but I cannot get in at all.
Locked out after too many attempts (my fault, new password manager). The unlock email link goes to a 404 page.

you DELETED our entire shared drive?!?! 40GB of client work, gone after your "migration". the folder is just empty. if this isn't restored today we are finished as a business and I will make sure everyone knows why
Who decided the menus should be light gray on white? I'm 58, not 18. I can barely read them. Offer a high-contrast option, this trendy nonsense helps no one.
It'd be helpful if the server control panel showed bandwidth usage per site rather than only per account.

I have now explained to FOUR different agents that I was charged for someone else's order. Each one asks me the same questions and vanishes. Is anyone there actually capable of reading a ticket history?
Our invoice lists 14 seats but we only have 12 active users; I removed two people back in June. We haven't paid it yet - it's due end of next month. Please correct.
I've been critical in the past, so it's only fair to say: the last three releases have been rock solid. Performance is night and day.
I was charged twice for my monthly subscription on the 3rd. Two identical charges of $29. Please refund one.

Our seed round closed and, according to your email, we must leave the startup program pricing by the 1st. What plan do we move to? Can someone confirm pricing before then so we're not dropped to the free tier?
A chargeback fee?? I only filed the dispute because YOUR support ignored me for three weeks about a wrong charge. Now you bill me $20 for the privilege. Unreal. Remove it.
Is there a minimum contract length on the dedicated servers or can I go month to month?
Hello, I'm writing a university paper on subscription businesses. Would someone be open to a brief interview about how you approach customer retention and churn?

We think our merchant account has been compromised: the payout bank details were changed last night to an account we don't recognise, and a payout of 14k is scheduled for tomorrow morning. Please stop it.
Two-factor codes by SMS arrive fine, but the authenticator-app option throws "invalid QR" when I try to set it up. I'm using SMS meanwhile.
Why is your pricing hidden behind "Contact sales"?? Just tell me the damn price. I'm not sitting through a demo to learn a number. Every company that pulls this is wasting my time.
I CANCELLED IN JUNE. Why is there a charge from you on my August statement?! I have the cancellation email. Refund me NOW or I dispute it with my bank.
Would you consider adding a Portuguese (Brazil) localisation? Several of our field staff would benefit.
The point-of-sale tablet app freezes on the payment screen whenever we ring up more than 5 items. We're a small cafe and have been writing orders on paper since opening today.
The invoice you sent for October has our old company address on it. We moved in August and I updated the profile back then. Could you reissue it with the correct address?

You've just direct-debited the ENTIRE year's hosting fee from every one of our 38 client accounts instead of the monthly amount. Clients are phoning me screaming. This is a catastrophic screwup. Reverse all of them TODAY.
Live incident: the trading platform is rejecting all orders with "market closed" while markets are open. Multiple members of our investment club confirm the same.
Love how the "Starter" plan went from $9 to $19 with the exact same features. Bold strategy. Anyway, is there a legacy price for people signing up again, or is that gone too? Not holding my breath.
Please downgrade us from Business to Team at the next renewal; we've shrunk and don't need the extra features.
When I hover over the chart legend the text flickers for a split second. Chrome on Mac. Low priority, works fine otherwise.
I'd like to upgrade from Basic to Pro but keep my current billing date. How do I do that?
Return window "closed" one day before I tried to return the jacket?? You count the shipping days as part of my 30 days?? That's a scam policy and you know it. I want my refund.
The mobile banking app has shown everyone in my family a balance of ZERO since this morning and Twitter is full of people with the same thing. Where is our money?? Not a word from you. Disgraceful.
I need a sales rep to contact me about moving from the self-serve plan to an enterprise agreement. We have around 120 users now.
Where are your servers located? Just curious whether my data stays in the EU.

hey so I think the password reset flow lets you reset anyone's password?? I typo'd my email and ended up logged into a stranger's account after clicking the link sent to MY inbox. logged out immediately. you should probably look at that like now
My gran's 90th birthday is on Sunday and I want to make a photo book with your service. How long does printing and delivery to Ireland usually take? Trying to work out if it's still doable.
My old laptop crashed mid-presentation last week and thanks to your autosave I didn't lose a single slide. You saved my skin. Thank you!!
We're researching vendors for a possible 2027 rollout. Do you support invoicing via a procurement marketplace like Ariba, and do you do multi-year pricing? Early stage, just collecting info.
I donated through your platform several times last year and need an annual giving statement for taxes. The one in my account only lists 3 of my 5 donations.
was charged a late fee of $25 but I paid on the due date - the bank transfer shows the 15th. pls remove the fee, it's already been taken from my card

Why do I have to CALL a phone number to get a refund for a gift card I accidentally bought twice? It's 2026. I'm not sitting on hold for an hour listening to your jazz. Process it over email like a normal company.
i never got a receipt for order #48213. payment went through fine and the shoes arrived, i just need the receipt for an expense report whenever you can
The price on the product page was 79.90 but I was charged 97.90 at checkout. I have a screenshot. Please refund the difference.
Student discount: I verified my student status two weeks ago and it was approved, but my upcoming renewal preview still shows full price. Renewal isn't until the 28th of next month.
We're a startup (4 people) and I heard you have a startup program with credits. Where can I read about eligibility and pricing after the credits run out?

Your largest reseller partner in the Nordics here. Deal registrations have been going unapproved for months, and we have lost three enterprise deals because of it. We've been approached by your main competitor to switch our whole portfolio (about 70 enterprise customers). We'll decide at our partner meeting next week; I'd rather stay, so please escalate.

This is the FIFTH outage of your email delivery this quarter and it's happening again right now - nothing has gone out since 6am, password resets, order confirmations, nothing. We're a 5,000-seat customer. My VP asked me this morning why we still use you and I had no answer. Give me one.
Hi, does the Pro tier include priority shipping or is that a separate add-on? Thinking about subscribing.
Does your brokerage offer lower fees for high-volume accounts? I trade roughly 200 times a month elsewhere at the moment.
Our trial expires tomorrow and we're ready to buy, but we need a quote with the 15% discount your rep mentioned. Can someone send it today?
Following up again (wrote on Monday and Wednesday): recurring tasks stopped generating new instances. It's a small bug I guess, but I've had no reply at all.
A ransom note appeared in our hosted file share this morning and the files now have the extension .lockd. We haven't touched anything. We need your security team urgently.
Could you explain what the "error budget" graph on the dashboard represents? Nothing's wrong, I just don't know the concept.
What's the difference between the Team and Business plans? The pricing page isn't totally clear about the API limits.
Renewal is this Friday and we want to drop from 60 to 45 seats before it auto-renews at the old count. Please confirm this can be done in time.
Can you tell me how to set up a recurring transfer? I want it in place before my rent is due on the 1st, which is this Sunday.

Your chatbot has now told me three different things about whether I can take the e-scooter battery on a plane. I fly on Friday. Can a HUMAN answer this, or is that too much to ask from a company that took $900 off me?
Multiple unauthorized withdrawals from my wallet tonight - five transfers of 200 each to a recipient I don't know. I've changed my password. Please freeze outgoing payments and reverse these.
I would like to cancel the auto-renewal of my VPN subscription but keep using it until it expires in November.
Messages sent through your SMS gateway have not been delivered for the last two hours. We're a hospital appointment reminder service; several thousand patients are affected.
Requesting an integration with Notion. We'd use it to push meeting summaries automatically.
Hi, do you have a public roadmap somewhere?
Search in the help center returns no results for anything with a hyphen in it, e.g. "single sign-on".
What currencies can I be billed in? We're opening an office in Canada next year and might move the account there eventually.
Our account got suspended this morning for non-payment, but the invoice was paid by wire on the 12th (remittance attached). The whole team is locked out. Please restore access and match the payment.
Do you have a pay-as-you-go option? I'd only need the tool about twice a year, so a monthly subscription doesn't make sense for me.
Kudos on the migration - I expected downtime on my sites and there was none whatsoever.
The tax on my invoice is calculated at 20% but we're a registered charity and should be exempt. How do I submit the exemption certificate so upcoming invoices are right?
you took 199 from my account for an ANNUAL plan. I clicked MONTHLY. I'm a student, that was my rent money. fix this today. this is theft
the new dark mode is gorgeous. that's it, that's the ticket :)
Can I use the same account on my phone and my laptop at the same time?

I've been a customer for 9 years and new customers get 50% off while I pay full price? Nice way to reward loyalty. Match the offer or I'll cancel and sign up again with a different email, your choice.
how do i turn on the crash reporting option you mentioned in the newsletter? i'd like to help you guys with diagnostics
could u send me a brochure or deck about your loyalty program pricing for merchants? no hurry
Your onboarding emails are actually useful, which is rare. Whoever writes them deserves a raise.

All donors to our campaign yesterday were charged 10x the amount they entered (a $25 gift became $250). About 180 donors affected so far. We've paused the campaign ourselves. We need mass refunds started right away.
Hello, I'd like to know whether the price on your website includes VAT for EU buyers before I consider ordering.
During the big cloud outage on Tuesday half the internet was down and your service didn't even blink. Impressive engineering. Tell the infra team they're appreciated.
Do you offer discounts for nonprofits? We're a small animal shelter considering your CRM sometime next year.
fyi the tooltip on the export button is in German even though my account is set to English. everything else is fine.

Second request: the two credit notes promised on our call three weeks ago still haven't been issued, so our balance with you looks 1,900 higher than it should be. Could someone confirm when they will be raised?
Do you have a student ambassador or community programme? I'd love to get involved.
Just wanted to say your support agent Priya was fantastic yesterday. Solved my problem in five minutes.
After last night's sync, all of my notes from the past two years are gone. The app shows an empty notebook on every device. Please tell me there's a backup.

I have emailed FOUR times to cancel my gym-app membership before the renewal on the 1st (that's in 3 days). Zero replies. If you charge me again after ignoring my cancellation I will go straight to my bank and the consumer authority.
In the budgeting app, transactions from my credit union are imported twice - once as pending and once as posted - so my totals are off until I delete the duplicates manually.
Tiny thing: on the settings page the word "Notifcations" is misspelled. No impact, just thought you'd want to know.
How do I change the language of the interface?
We have a board meeting on Monday where I need to present final pricing for the enterprise tier. Could I get the proposal by end of week?
I run a small bakery and your invoicing tool has cut my admin time in half. I used to dread billing day, now it's 20 minutes. Thanks for building it.
Payroll runs tomorrow and our payout from your platform (last week's sales, approx 8,200) has been stuck "in review" since Monday. We have employees to pay. What do you need from us to release it?
Push notifications arrive about 10 minutes late on my Android phone. Email notifications are on time so I'm getting by.
Suggestion: allow merchants to issue partial refunds to their customers from the mobile app, not just from desktop. I often handle returns on the shop floor.
We're launching a pop-up shop this Saturday and want to rent 6 more POS terminals short-term, if you offer that. Need to know by tomorrow so we can arrange an alternative otherwise.
Procurement needs a signed order form and your W-9 by Thursday to get this into the current budget cycle. Otherwise the purchase slips to next quarter.

I asked for a refund on a $4.99 sticker pack and got a canned reply saying "digital goods are non-refundable". My kid bought it by accident. It's five bucks, are you really this greedy? Stingy clowns.
every time i rotate my tablet your app resets the form i was filling. EVERY time. i've retyped my address like 6 times now. how is this still a thing, do you hate your users?
Is there an education plan? I teach a high school coding class.

I'll be blunt. Three missed go-live dates for the enterprise rollout, a customer success manager who doesn't return calls, and now a surprise "platform fee" in the renewal. Our CEO wants out and so do I. This is a shambles. Termination letter goes out end of week unless someone senior shows up with a real plan.
Auto-renewed me with NO warning for a domain I don't even use anymore, $74.99. I turned auto-renew OFF last year, I remember doing it. You people flipped it back on. Reverse it.
Just curious - if I switch the card on file, does the billing date change or stay the same?
Charged in full for an order that was split - half of it was cancelled by you as out of stock, but my card was billed for everything. Order 99120.
Is it possible to pay annually by bank transfer instead of card? We're on monthly right now and it's working fine, just exploring options for the next fiscal year.
Is the API rate limit per key or per account? Planning an integration for later this year.
STOP charging me. I deleted my account two months ago and you are STILL pulling 9.99 every month. How is that even legal? I want all of it back.
Refund came through in under 24 hours after I returned the headphones. Didn't expect it that fast. Great service.

You debited my account TWICE for the loan repayment this month. That put me into overdraft and now my bank is charging me fees. Whoever runs your payment system should be fired. Send the money back today.
My daughter learned to read with your app. She's 5 and just finished her first book on her own. I'm a bit emotional writing this. Thank you.
Order never shipped. Cancelled by you. It's been 16 days and still no money back. Every time I ask I get "it takes 3-5 days". IT HAS BEEN SIXTEEN.

I've asked TWICE whether your granola is produced in a nut-free facility. My son has an allergy and the birthday party is Saturday. It's a yes or no question. How is it possible that nobody over there can answer it?
We're giving a workshop on Friday for 30 people using your whiteboard tool. Is there a limit on simultaneous editors per board? Need to know before then so we can plan the groups.
The CSV export puts dates in US format even though my locale is set to UK. I can fix it in Excel but it's an extra step every week.
Multi-select in the file manager. In 2026 this shouldn't even need asking. Is your product team asleep at the wheel or just allergic to the obvious? Add it.

Your collections agency just called our CEO about an "unpaid" 60k invoice that we paid in FULL in April - I have the wire confirmation. We've been an enterprise customer for six years. This is the third time your AR has lost a payment of ours. One more incident and we walk; honestly we may walk anyway. Get your finance director on the phone.
Quick one: do the receipts you email count as valid tax invoices in Australia, or would I need to request something different?
I want to remove my ex-business partner's card from the account but the system won't let me delete the only card on file, and I don't want to add mine until the new company card arrives next month.

Your latest firmware update bricked my router's config page. Can't change ANY settings, can't even see connected devices. I work from home and need to set up port forwarding for my VPN today. Who tests this stuff, a hamster?
Your desktop sync client has been "indexing" for TWO DAYS and blocks me from opening any of my synced folders. I've sent logs twice. Nobody replies. Is there anybody alive over there??

The logo in the top left has been 2 pixels off-centre since the last update and it is DRIVING ME NUTS. How does nobody at your company notice this?? Do you even look at your own product? Fix the stupid logo.

Cannot deploy: the build pipeline on your platform has been stuck at "queued" for 3 hours for my project. Other people on the community Slack say theirs work, so maybe it's just my account. I have a release planned for tomorrow morning.

Enterprise account #E-4471. For three cycles running your system has failed to collect our direct debit and then suspended our 900 users for non-payment, although the mandate is valid and the funds are there. Procurement has put the renewal on hold. Unless there is a permanent fix and a named contact by Friday, we will be moving to another vendor.

WHAT IS GOING ON. Every single one of our 300+ customers got charged TWICE by your subscription billing engine last night. My inbox is on fire, people are calling us thieves. Fix it NOW and tell me how you're refunding them.

Your account team has changed FOUR times in a year, nobody knows our setup, and every renewal conversation starts from zero. We're your biggest customer in the region (2,000 seats) and we're treated like a trial user. I've told procurement to start the exit plan. Convince me otherwise, fast.
I believe I've found a way to view other customers' order details by changing the order ID in the URL. I stopped after confirming it with two IDs. Reporting so you can fix it quickly.
Do you have a reseller or affiliate programme? I run an agency and recommend tools to clients.
We need a corrected invoice with our tax ID before Friday - our auditors close the books then and without it we can't book the expense.
My free trial was supposed to last 14 days. I was billed $59 on day 6. I hadn't even decided whether to keep it. Please reverse the charge.
Could you add Apple Pay as a checkout option? I'd buy more often if I didn't have to dig out my card.

My mother is 81. Someone got into her account and bought $2,300 of gift cards with her saved card while she was asleep. Your "fraud team" told her to fill in a web form and wait 10 days. Are you out of your minds? Freeze it and refund her.
I want to cancel. Your product has gotten worse with every update and the price went up anyway. Don't send me a retention offer, don't ask me for a survey. Just cancel the subscription.
I need this refund processed before the 30th (3 days from now) - my bank is closing that card account and the money will bounce otherwise.
I was told I'd get a $15 referral credit when my friend signed up. She joined three weeks ago and has paid twice, but there's no credit on my account yet.
URGENT: please add emoji reactions to comments!! Our team would love this asap, it's the one thing we miss from our old tool :)
Bought a flight voucher through your travel app, payment taken (£182), but no voucher code ever arrived. The flight booking needs to be made by Sunday.

For the fourth consecutive month your invoices to us are wrong - wrong entity, wrong amounts, duplicate lines. Our CFO has had enough. We spend 400k a year with you and if this is not permanently fixed and the credit issued this week, legal is drafting the termination notice. I'm done being polite about it.

I'm the CIO at Norvane Logistics, 3,200 seats. After the repeated reliability problems of the last two quarters, the steering committee voted yesterday to go to RFP. I'm willing to have one conversation with your leadership before the RFP is issued on Monday. Please have your VP call me.

THIRD TIME writing about the broken invoice generator in your app - the one I use to bill my own clients. It produces blank PDFs. You closed my last two tickets as "resolved" without doing a thing. Don't you dare close this one.
Your newsletter is smug and way too long. Nobody cares about your "journey". Send release notes, skip the poetry.
We need our invoices to show a PO number. Can you add PO-2291 to the September invoice and resend? Our AP department won't process it otherwise, though payment isn't due for another 45 days.
Hello, I switched from monthly to yearly mid-cycle and I don't understand how the prorated credit was calculated. The numbers may well be right, I'd just like a breakdown.
Hey, when my annual plan ends in March will you warn me before charging or does it just go through? Want to put a reminder in my calendar.
Hi, I upgraded and was told I'd only pay the difference, but the full price of the higher plan was taken on top of what I already paid for this month. Could you refund the overlap please?
I'm on the free plan and have hit the project limit. I'd like to buy just 5 extra projects as an add-on rather than going to the full paid tier - can you set that up for my account?

A third-party seller sent me the wrong size and now YOUR marketplace wants ME to pay return shipping to get my refund?? Absolutely not. This is your seller's screwup. Sort out a prepaid label and stop wasting my time.
Hi, second time writing. My invoice #INV-5512 still shows as unpaid and I keep getting dunning emails, though my bank confirms the payment cleared on the 9th. Can you please reconcile it?
DNS for all domains on your nameservers stopped resolving about 20 minutes ago. It's not just us - there's a thread on Hacker News.
Need to upgrade to the plan with more API calls today - we'll hit our monthly cap by tomorrow at the current rate and the upgrade button says "contact sales" for our account type.
Your system charged my card $120 for the renewal when the email you sent LAST WEEK said the renewal would be $89. Bait and switch. I want the $31 back and an explanation, not a coupon.

I'm colour-blind and the red/green status dots on the dashboard are indistinguishable to me. I can hover over each one to read the label, but it slows me down a lot. Could you add shapes or a colour-blind palette?

We've been asking for a renewal contract that reflects the terms we agreed in MARCH. It is now SEPTEMBER. Six months of "legal is reviewing". We are a seven-figure account and your competitor's paper is sitting on my desk ready to sign. You have until Friday, then we're gone. Unbelievable incompetence.
Is it possible to hand over my domain's DNS management to a colleague's account? I go on leave on Wednesday and he'll be in charge after that. Instructions would be appreciated.
THE APP LOST MY BABY'S PHOTOS. "Optimizing storage" it said, and now 14 months of pictures are blank gray squares, in the cloud too. I trusted you with this. I am shaking with rage. Get them back.
How does the round-up savings feature decide what to round to? Nearest dollar, or can it be configured?
Minor visual glitch in dark mode: the divider line between the sidebar and main panel disappears. Doesn't affect anything.

Do you people have ANY monitoring? Your CDN has been serving our customers a certificate error for two hours. Every visitor to our site sees a big red NOT SECURE warning. I had to find out from a customer's tweet.
Nothing changed on our side. The managed Kubernetes control plane in eu-west has been unreachable for 25 minutes and our production workloads can't scale or deploy. Ticket opened via phone as well.
tender submission deadline is 12 noon on Thursday. we need your reseller authorization letter to include in our bid to the city council. pls treat as time-sensitive
Database cluster db-prod-3 became unreachable at 02:10. Failover did not trigger. Our application is fully down for all tenants. We need an engineer on this now.
Hi, could you tell me what day of the month my subscription renews? I can't remember when I signed up. No rush at all.

Hello. Our enterprise subscription (global, ~9,000 employees) is up for renewal at month end. Given the unresolved contractual dispute over the data processing terms that has dragged on since spring, our legal department has advised non-renewal. We'd still prefer to stay. Could an executive sponsor contact our General Counsel urgently?
Timezone issue: scheduled posts go out an hour late since the clocks changed. I've been compensating by scheduling everything an hour earlier.
Dashboard widgets take 8-10 seconds to load since last week. It used to be instant. Everything works, it's just slow.
please add a dark theme to the web dashboard, my eyes beg you
Video playback stutters every few seconds on your player ONLY. Netflix, YouTube all fine on the same wifi. Don't tell me to restart my router. It's your crappy player.
I need to submit my tax filing through your app by Friday midnight but the "submit" step throws error E-1105 every time.
Are your mailer bags recyclable? Asking for my own sorting at home.

Your checkout API is CHARGING PEOPLE AND NOT CREATING ORDERS. Since 9am: 60+ shoppers charged, zero orders in our system, and it's still happening with every purchase. We look like scammers. WHERE IS YOUR ON-CALL??
Your "eco-friendly" brand ships a lipstick in a box big enough for boots, stuffed with plastic pillows. Hypocrites. Do better with the packaging.
calendar sync with Google is one-way only for me: events created in your app show up in Google but not vice versa. It's been like that since I connected it.
The video consultation feature shows a black screen for me and my patients. I have four appointments this afternoon.
Simple question your "help center" couldn't answer after 15 minutes of my life: what does the little blue dot next to a contact's name mean? Your documentation is a wasteland.
App crashes on launch. Every time. Since the update this morning. I use this for work and I've now lost half a day. Reinstalled twice. FIX IT.
Since the redesign I find it genuinely hard to locate the monthly summary - it takes me several minutes every time. It's not broken, I know, but the old placement worked much better for me.
We rotated nothing, yet our API secret appears on a public paste site along with other companies' keys that look like they're from your platform. Possible breach on your side? Details attached.
Third time asking this simple question: can the kids' profile be restricted to certain hours? Nobody has replied to my previous two messages.
Production API is returning 503 for all requests since 10:42 UTC. All of our customers are affected. Your status page shows green. Please escalate.
Requesting refund for unused SMS credits - we bought 10k credits, used about 600, and are moving to a different notification approach. Is a partial refund possible?
Second email. I asked to downgrade BEFORE the renewal date, which is the day after tomorrow. If I get bumped into another year of Premium because you lot sat on this, we're going to have a problem.
Tried to downgrade and your site makes me "chat with a specialist" who then pitched me three upsells. I said downgrade. D-O-W-N-G-R-A-D-E. Put me on the cheap plan and stop the sales theater.
Could someone walk me through upgrading my business account to the tier with multi-currency IBANs? I couldn't work out from the site whether my company type qualifies.
The order tracking page shows "label created" but the courier's own site says it was delivered yesterday. Looks like your tracking isn't updating.
